<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>谷子排发追踪</title>
<script src="https://cdn.bootcdn.net/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;background:#f5f4f0;color:#1a1a1a;min-height:100vh}
.header{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #e8e6e0;padding:14px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100}
.header h1{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;flex:1}
.version{font-size:11px;color:#999;background:#f0efe9;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px}
.sync-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#3aad7a;flex-shrink:0}
.sync-dot.offline{background:#e07b39}
.main{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 16px}
.upload-section{margin-bottom:20px}.upload-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.sec-label{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#999;margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:.4px}
.upload-zone{background:#fff;border:2px dashed #d4d0c8;border-radius:14px;padding:22px 16px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s}
.upload-zone:hover,.upload-zone.drag{border-color:#7a6ef0;background:#f8f7ff}
.upload-zone .ico{font-size:26px;margin-bottom:7px}
.upload-zone h4{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#333;margin-bottom:3px}
.upload-zone p{font-size:12px;color:#aaa}
.upload-zone.loaded{border-color:#3aad7a;border-style:solid;background:#f0fdf6}
.upload-zone.loaded h4{color:#3aad7a}
.upload-zone.uploading{border-color:#f0c040;pointer-events:none;opacity:0.65}
.main-status{margin-top:10px;padding:10px 14px;background:#f0fdf6;border:1px solid #b7f0d4;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;color:#2d8a5e}
.file-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}
.file-tag{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e0ddd6;border-radius:20px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:12px;color:#555}
.file-tag .rm{cursor:pointer;color:#bbb;font-size:15px}.file-tag .rm:hover{color:#d9534f}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:18px}
.stat{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid #eee}
.stat .lbl{font-size:11px;color:#999;margin-bottom:4px}
.stat .val{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;color:#1a1a1a}
.stat.warn .val{color:#e07b39}.stat.ok .val{color:#3aad7a}
.controls{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.search-box{flex:1;min-width:200px;position:relative}
.search-box input{width:100%;padding:8px 12px 8px 34px;border:1px solid #e0ddd6;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;background:#fff;outline:none}
.search-ico{position:absolute;left:11px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:#bbb;font-size:14px}
.filters{display:flex;gap:6px}
.fbtn{padding:7px 14px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #e0ddd6;background:#fff;font-size:13px;color:#666;cursor:pointer}
.fbtn.active{background:#7a6ef0;color:#fff;border-color:#7a6ef0}
.small-btn{padding:5px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #e0ddd6;background:#fff;font-size:12px;color:#666;cursor:pointer}
.small-btn.danger{border-color:#f0c4c4;color:#d9534f}
.member-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.mcard{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #eee;overflow:hidden}
.mcard:hover{box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.07)}
.mhead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 14px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
.avatar{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:#e8e5fc;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#7a6ef0;flex-shrink:0}
.mname{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;flex:1}
.prog{font-size:12px;color:#999}
.badge{font-size:11px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:500}
.badge.pending{background:#fff3eb;color:#e07b39}
.badge.done{background:#eafaf3;color:#3aad7a}
.chev{color:#ccc;font-size:18px;transition:transform 0.2s;margin-left:2px}
.chev.open{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.items{display:none;border-top:1px solid #f0efe9}.items.open{display:block}
.src-label{font-size:10px;padding:4px 14px;background:#f9f8f5;color:#bbb;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.3px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0efe9}
.irow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #f5f4f0;transition:background 0.1s}
.irow:last-child{border-bottom:none}.irow:hover{background:#fafaf8}
.irow:hover .irow-actions{opacity:1}.irow.sent{opacity:0.4}
.irow input[type=checkbox]{width:16px;height:16px;cursor:pointer;accent-color:#7a6ef0;flex-shrink:0}
.iname{font-size:13px;flex:1;min-width:0}.iname.sent{text-decoration:line-through;color:#bbb}
.iqty{font-size:12px;color:#999;background:#f5f4f0;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:20px;white-space:nowrap}
.irow-actions{display:flex;gap:4px;opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.15s;flex-shrink:0}
.iact{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #e8e5e0;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#888}
.iact.edit-btn:hover{background:#f0eeff;border-color:#c4bafc;color:#7a6ef0}
.iact.del-btn:hover{background:#fff0f0;border-color:#f5c0c0;color:#d9534f}
.irow.editing .iname-static{display:none}
.irow.editing .iname-edit{display:flex!important}
.iname-edit{display:none;gap:6px;flex:1;align-items:center}
.iname-edit input{flex:1;padding:3px 7px;border:1px solid #c4bafc;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;outline:none;min-width:0}
.iname-edit input.qty-in{width:52px;flex:none}
.iname-edit .save-btn{padding:3px 10px;background:#7a6ef0;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}
.iname-edit .cancel-btn{padding:3px 8px;background:#f0efe9;color:#888;border:none;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}
.empty{padding:3rem;text-align:center;color:#bbb}
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);background:#333;color:#fff;padding:8px 18px;border-radius:20px;font-size:13px;opacity:0;transition:all 0.25s;pointer-events:none;z-index:999}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.meme-overlay{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.7);z-index:9999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;animation:fadeIn 0.6s ease-out}
.meme-popup{background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:24px;text-align:center;max-width:400px;width:90%;animation:bounceIn 0.5s ease-out}
.meme-popup img{width:100%;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.meme-popup button{background:#7a6ef0;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:30px;padding:10px 40px;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s}
.meme-popup button:hover{background:#6255e0;transform:scale(1.05)}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes bounceIn{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(0.7)}60%{transform:scale(1.05)}100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
.meme-overlay.hidden{animation:fadeOut 0.3s ease-in forwards}
@keyframes fadeOut{from{opacity:1}to{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}}
.auth-overlay{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.75);z-index:10000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.auth-box{background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:30px 24px;text-align:center;max-width:380px;width:90%;animation:popIn 0.4s ease-out}
.auth-box h2{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:6px;color:#333}
.auth-box .sub{font-size:13px;color:#999;margin-bottom:20px}
.auth-box .btn-row{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.auth-box button{border:none;border-radius:30px;padding:10px 24px;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.15s}
.btn-admin{background:#7a6ef0;color:#fff}.btn-admin:hover{background:#6255e0}
.btn-member{background:#f0efe9;color:#666}.btn-member:hover{background:#e0ddd6}
.auth-box .pw-row{display:none;margin-top:16px;gap:8px;justify-content:center}
.auth-box .pw-row.show{display:flex}
.auth-box .pw-row input{padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;width:140px;outline:none}
.auth-box .pw-row input:focus{border-color:#7a6ef0}
.auth-box .err{color:#d9534f;font-size:12px;margin-top:6px;display:none}
@keyframes popIn{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(0.8)}100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
.view-only .irow input[type=checkbox]{pointer-events:none;opacity:0.5}
.view-only .irow-actions{display:none!important}
.view-only .upload-section{display:none!important}
.view-only .small-btn.danger{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:600px){.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.upload-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}.irow-actions{opacity:1}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="auth-overlay" id="auth-overlay"><div class="auth-box"><h2>🎌 谷子排发追踪</h2><div class="sub">请选择你的身份</div><div class="btn-row"><button class="btn-admin" onclick="showPw()">🔑 我是管理</button><button class="btn-member" onclick="enterAsMember()">👤 我是团员</button></div><div class="pw-row" id="pw-row"><input type="password" id="pw-input" placeholder="输入密码" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')checkPw()"><button class="btn-admin" onclick="checkPw()">确认</button></div><div class="err" id="pw-err">密码错误</div></div></div>
<div class="meme-overlay" id="meme-overlay"><div class="meme-popup"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""><br><button onclick="dismissMeme()">你别管</button></div></div>
<div class="header"><h1>🎌 谷子排发追踪</h1><span class="sync-dot" id="sync-dot"></span><span class="version">v10</span></div>
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>
<div class="main">
<div class="upload-section"><div class="upload-row">
<div><div class="sec-label">📋 内嵌总表（221人 / 1001件）</div><div class="upload-zone loaded"><div class="ico">✅</div><h4>总表已内嵌</h4><p>无需上传，开箱即用</p></div><div class="main-status">📦 总表已就绪，共 <b>221</b> 位团员 / <b>1001</b> 件谷子</div></div>

</div></div>
<div id="app"><div class="empty" style="padding:60px">加载中…</div></div>
</div>

var DB = 'https://nngdthnpydcxnjjhmpkf.supabase.co/rest/v1';
var KEY = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6Im5uZ2R0aG5weWRjeG5qamhtcGtmIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3ODExNDc0MjUsImV4cCI6MjA5NjcyMzQyNX0.bHIz5jLuszqfa1btarOlepupNo7ga3B8dIEtHNl44LQ';

function dbfetch(path, opts) {
  var h = { 'apikey': KEY, 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + KEY, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
  if (opts && opts.headers) Object.assign(h, opts.headers);
  return fetch(DB + path, { method: opts ? opts.method || 'GET' : 'GET', headers: h, body: opts && opts.body })
    .then(function(r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.text(); })
    .then(function(t) { return t ? JSON.parse(t) : null; });
}

var sentMap = {}, editsMap = {}, delsArr = [], subItems = [], memberIdMap = {};
var curF = 'all', curQ = '';

function toast(m) { var t = document.getElementById('toast'); t.textContent = m; t.classList.add('show'); clearTimeout(window._tt); window._tt = setTimeout(function(){ t.classList.remove('show'); }, 2200); }

async function loadState() {
  var row = await dbfetch('/app_state?id=eq.1');
  var st = (row && row.length) ? row[0] : { sent_map: {}, edits_map: {}, dels_set: [] };
  sentMap = st.sent_map || {}; editsMap = st.edits_map || {}; delsArr = st.dels_set || [];
  var items = await dbfetch('/items?select=id,member_id,name,qty,src,sent,edited_name,edited_qty,deleted&order=id');
  subItems = items || [];
  var mems = await dbfetch('/members?select=id,name&order=name');
  memberIdMap = {}; (mems || []).forEach(function(m) { memberIdMap[m.id] = m.name; });
  document.getElementById('sync-dot').className = 'sync-dot';
}

async function saveState() {
  await dbfetch('/app_state?id=eq.1', { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify({ sent_map: sentMap, edits_map: editsMap, dels_set: delsArr }) });
}

// === 数据合并 ===
function getMerged() {
  var map = {};
  EMBEDDED.forEach(function(m) {
    if (!map[m.name]) map[m.name] = [];
    m.items.forEach(function(it, i) {
      var k = m.name + '||' + i;
      if (delsArr.indexOf(k) !== -1) return;
      map[m.name].push({ name: (editsMap[k] && editsMap[k].name) || it.name, qty: (editsMap[k] && editsMap[k].qty) || it.qty, src: it.src || '总表', _idx: i, _sub: false });
    });
  });
  subItems.forEach(function(it) {
    if (it.deleted) return;
    var mn = memberIdMap[it.member_id]; if (!mn) return;
    if (!map[mn]) map[mn] = [];
    map[mn].push({ name: it.edited_name || it.name, qty: it.edited_qty || it.qty, src: it.src, _dbId: it.id, _sent: it.sent, _sub: true });
  });
  var res = [];
  Object.keys(map).forEach(function(name) { if (map[name].length) res.push({ name: name, items: map[name] }); });
  return res;
}

function sent(m, it) { return it._sub ? !!it._sent : !!sentMap[m.name + '||' + it._idx]; }
function stats(m) { var t = m.items.length, s = m.items.filter(function(it) { return sent(m, it); }).length; return { total: t, sent: s, pending: t - s }; }

// === 渲染 ===
var _open = {};
function render() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.items.open').forEach(function(el) {
    var c = el.closest('.mcard'), n = c && c.querySelector('.mname');
    if (n) _open[n.textContent] = true;
  });
  var merged = getMerged(), q = curQ.trim().toLowerCase();
  var filtered = merged.filter(function(m) {
    var st = stats(m);
    if (curF === 'pending' && st.pending === 0) return false;
    if (curF === 'done' && st.pending > 0) return false;
    if (q && m.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) === -1 && !m.items.some(function(it) { return it.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; })) return false;
    return true;
  });
  var pc = 0, pi = 0, dc = 0;
  filtered.forEach(function(m) { var st = stats(m); if (st.pending > 0) { pc++; pi += st.pending; } else dc++; });
  var sv = curQ.replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  var h = '<div class="stats"><div class="stat"><div class="lbl">团员总数</div><div class="val">' + filtered.length + '</div></div><div class="stat warn"><div class="lbl">有未发货</div><div class="val">' + pc + '</div></div><div class="stat"><div class="lbl">待发件数</div><div class="val">' + pi + '</div></div><div class="stat ok"><div class="lbl">已全发完</div><div class="val">' + dc + '</div></div></div>';
  h += '<div class="controls"><div class="search-box"><span class="search-ico">🔍</span><input type="text" id="search" placeholder="搜索团员或谷子名称…" value="' + sv + '"></div><div class="filters"><button class="fbtn ' + (curF==='all'?'active':'') + '" data-filter="all">全部</button><button class="fbtn ' + (curF==='pending'?'active':'') + '" data-filter="pending">⚠️ 有未发</button><button class="fbtn ' + (curF==='done'?'active':'') + '" data-filter="done">✅ 已全发</button></div><button class="small-btn danger" onclick="resetAll()">清空已发货</button></div>';
  h += '<div class="member-list">';
  if (!filtered.length && merged.length) h += '<div class="empty">没有匹配的结果</div>';
  filtered.forEach(function(m) {
    var st = stats(m);
    h += '<div class="mcard"><div class="mhead" onclick="tCard(this)"><div class="avatar">' + m.name.slice(0,2) + '</div><div class="mname">' + m.name + '</div><div class="prog">' + st.sent + '/' + st.total + '</div><span class="badge ' + (st.pending===0?'done':'pending') + '">' + (st.pending===0?'✓ 全部已发':'待发 '+st.pending+' 件') + '</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div><div class="items">';
    var grp = {};
    m.items.forEach(function(it) { if (!grp[it.src]) grp[it.src] = []; grp[it.src].push(it); });
    Object.keys(grp).forEach(function(src) {
      h += '<div class="src-label">' + src + '</div>';
      grp[src].forEach(function(it) {
        var s = sent(m, it);
        var id = it._sub ? 's_' + it._dbId : 'e_' + encodeURIComponent(m.name) + '_' + it._idx;
        var hl = q && it.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 ? 'background:#fff8e1;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px;' : '';
        h += '<div class="irow ' + (s?'sent':'') + '" data-id="' + id + '"><input type="checkbox" ' + (s?'checked':'') + ' onchange="tSent(this)"><span class="iname-static iname ' + (s?'sent':'') + '" style="' + hl + '">' + it.name + '</span><div class="iname-edit"><input class="name-in"><input class="qty-in" type="number" min="1"><button class="save-btn" onclick="sEdit(this)">保存</button><button class="cancel-btn" onclick="cEdit(this)">取消</button></div><span class="iqty">×' + it.qty + '</span><div class="irow-actions"><button class="iact edit-btn" onclick="bEdit(this)">✏️</button><button class="iact del-btn" onclick="dItem(this)">🗑</button></div></div>';
      });
    });
    h += '</div></div>';
  });
  h += '</div>';
  document.getElementById('app').innerHTML = h;
  document.getElementById('search').addEventListener('input', function(e) { curQ = e.target.value; render(); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.fbtn').forEach(function(b) { b.addEventListener('click', function() { curF = b.dataset.filter; render(); }); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.mcard').forEach(function(card) {
    var n = card.querySelector('.mname');
    if (n && (_open[n.textContent] || q)) { card.querySelector('.items').classList.add('open'); card.querySelector('.chev').classList.add('open'); }
  });
  _open = {};
  upTags();
}

// === 操作 ===
window.tCard = function(h) { h.nextElementSibling.classList.toggle('open'); h.querySelector('.chev').classList.toggle('open'); };

async function tSent(cb) {
  var row = cb.closest('.irow'), id = row.dataset.id;
  var merged = getMerged(), target = null, mem = null;
  for (var i = 0; i < merged.length && !target; i++) {
    var m = merged[i];
    for (var j = 0; j < m.items.length; j++) {
      var it = m.items[j];
      var cid = it._sub ? 's_' + it._dbId : 'e_' + encodeURIComponent(m.name) + '_' + it._idx;
      if (cid === id) { target = it; mem = m; break; }
    }
  }
  if (!target) return;
  if (target._sub) {
    await dbfetch('/items?id=eq.' + target._dbId, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify({ sent: cb.checked }) });
  } else {
    var key = mem.name + '||' + target._idx;
    if (cb.checked) sentMap[key] = 1; else delete sentMap[key];
    try { await saveState(); } catch(e) {}
  }
  render();
}
window.tSent = tSent;

window.bEdit = function(btn) {
  var row = btn.closest('.irow'), n = row.querySelector('.iname-static').textContent, q = row.querySelector('.iqty').textContent;
  row.classList.add('editing'); row.querySelector('.name-in').value = n;
  row.querySelector('.qty-in').value = parseInt(q.replace('×','')) || 1;
  row.querySelector('.iqty').style.display = 'none'; row.querySelector('.irow-actions').style.display = 'none';
};
window.cEdit = function(btn) {
  var row = btn.closest('.irow'); row.classList.remove('editing');
  row.querySelector('.iqty').style.display = ''; row.querySelector('.irow-actions').style.display = '';
};
async function sEdit(btn) {
  var row = btn.closest('.irow'), id = row.dataset.id, nm = row.querySelector('.name-in').value.trim(), q = parseInt(row.querySelector('.qty-in').value) || 1;
  if (!nm) { toast('名称不能为空'); return; }
  var merged = getMerged(), target = null, mem = null;
  for (var i = 0; i < merged.length && !target; i++) {
    var m = merged[i];
    for (var j = 0; j < m.items.length; j++) {
      var it = m.items[j];
      var cid = it._sub ? 's_' + it._dbId : 'e_' + encodeURIComponent(m.name) + '_' + it._idx;
      if (cid === id) { target = it; mem = m; break; }
    }
  }
  if (!target) return;
  if (target._sub) {
    await dbfetch('/items?id=eq.' + target._dbId, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify({ edited_name: nm, edited_qty: q }) });
  } else {
    editsMap[mem.name + '||' + target._idx] = { name: nm, qty: q };
    try { await saveState(); } catch(e) {}
  }
  toast('已保存');
  await loadState(); render();
}
window.sEdit = sEdit;

async function dItem(btn) {
  var row = btn.closest('.irow'), id = row.dataset.id;
  if (!confirm('确认删除？')) return;
  var merged = getMerged(), target = null, mem = null;
  for (var i = 0; i < merged.length && !target; i++) {
    var m = merged[i];
    for (var j = 0; j < m.items.length; j++) {
      var it = m.items[j];
      var cid = it._sub ? 's_' + it._dbId : 'e_' + encodeURIComponent(m.name) + '_' + it._idx;
      if (cid === id) { target = it; mem = m; break; }
    }
  }
  if (!target) return;
  if (target._sub) {
    await dbfetch('/items?id=eq.' + target._dbId, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify({ deleted: true }) });
  } else {
    delsArr.push(mem.name + '||' + target._idx);
    delete sentMap[mem.name + '||' + target._idx];
    try { await saveState(); } catch(e) {}
  }
  toast('已删除');
  await loadState(); render();
}
window.dItem = dItem;

async function resetAll() {
  if (!confirm('确认全部重置为未发货？')) return;
  sentMap = {};
  await saveState();
  toast('已全部重置');
  await loadState(); render();
}
window.resetAll = resetAll;

// === 子表 ===
function upTags() {
  var set = {};
  subItems.forEach(function(it) { if (!it.deleted && it.src !== '总表') set[it.src] = true; });
  var tags = document.getElementById('sub-tags'); tags.innerHTML = '';
  Object.keys(set).forEach(function(src) {
    var t = 0, ms = {};
    subItems.filter(function(it) { return it.src === src && !it.deleted; }).forEach(function(it) { t++; if (memberIdMap[it.member_id]) ms[memberIdMap[it.member_id]] = true; });
    var tag = document.createElement('div'); tag.className = 'file-tag';
    tag.innerHTML = '<span>📄 ' + src + ' (' + Object.keys(ms).length + '人/' + t + '件)</span><span class="rm" onclick="rmSub(&quot;' + src.replace(/"/g,'&quot;') + '&quot;)">×</span>';
    tags.appendChild(tag);
  });
}

// Excel 解析
function parseSub(data, filename) {
  var wb = XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array' }), result = [];
  wb.SheetNames.forEach(function(sn) {
    var ws = wb.Sheets[sn], rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, { header: 1, defval: null });
    if (rows.length < 3) return;
    var hRow = rows[0], cols = [];
    for (var c = 2; c < hRow.length; c++) { var v = hRow[c]; if (v && String(v).trim()) cols.push({ col: c, name: String(v).trim() }); }
    var lRow = rows[2], nc = 2;
    if (lRow) for (var c2 = 0; c2 < lRow.length; c2++) { if (lRow[c2] === '昵称') { nc = c2; break; } }
    for (var r = 3; r < rows.length; r++) {
      var row = rows[r]; if (!row[nc] || !String(row[nc]).trim()) continue;
      var name = String(row[nc]).trim(), items = [];
      cols.forEach(function(ic) { if (row[ic.col] && String(row[ic.col]).trim()) items.push({ name: ic.name, qty: parseInt(row[ic.col]) || 1, src: filename }); });
      if (items.length) result.push({ name: name, items: items });
    }
  });
  return result;
}

document.getElementById('input-sub').addEventListener('change', async function(e) {
  var file = e.target.files[0]; if (!file) return;
  var fname = file.name, zone = document.getElementById('zone-sub'); zone.classList.add('uploading');
  var reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = async function(ev) {
    try {
      var parsed = parseSub(new Uint8Array(ev.target.result), fname);
      if (!parsed.length) { alert('未能识别分表内容'); zone.classList.remove('uploading'); return; }
      // 删旧
      await dbfetch('/items?src=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(fname), { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify({ deleted: true }) });
      // 插新
      for (var i = 0; i < parsed.length; i++) {
        var m = parsed[i];
        var exist = await dbfetch('/members?name=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(m.name) + '&select=id');
        var mid;
        if (exist && exist.length) { mid = exist[0].id; }
        else {
          var cr = await dbfetch('/members', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ name: m.name }), headers: { 'Prefer': 'return=representation' } });
          mid = cr && cr.length ? cr[0].id : null;
        }
        if (!mid) continue;
        var its = m.items.map(function(it) { return { member_id: mid, name: it.name, qty: it.qty, src: fname }; });
        for (var j = 0; j < its.length; j += 100) {
          await dbfetch('/items', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(its.slice(j, j + 100)), headers: { 'Prefer': 'return=minimal' } });
        }
      }
      toast('分表已上传：' + parsed.length + '人');
      zone.classList.add('loaded'); zone.querySelector('h4').textContent = '✓ ' + fname;
      await loadState(); render();
    } catch(err) { alert('上传失败: ' + err.message); }
    zone.classList.remove('uploading');
  };
  reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file); this.value = '';
});

window.rmSub = async function(filename) {
  if (!confirm('确认删除分表 "' + filename + '"？')) return;
  await dbfetch('/items?src=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(filename), { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify({ deleted: true }) });
  toast('已删除：' + filename);
  await loadState(); render();
};

// 拖拽
['zone-sub'].forEach(function(id) {
  var zone = document.getElementById(id);
  zone.addEventListener('dragover', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); zone.classList.add('drag'); });
  zone.addEventListener('dragleave', function() { zone.classList.remove('drag'); });
  zone.addEventListener('drop', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault(); zone.classList.remove('drag');
    var file = e.dataTransfer.files[0]; if (!file) return;
    var dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file);
    document.getElementById('input-sub').files = dt.files;
    document.getElementById('input-sub').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  });
});

// === 权限 ===
function dismissMeme(){ var el=document.getElementById('meme-overlay'); el.classList.add('hidden'); setTimeout(function(){ el.remove(); }, 300); }
var USER_ROLE = sessionStorage.getItem('guzi_role') || '';
if (USER_ROLE === 'member') document.body.classList.add('view-only');
if (!USER_ROLE) document.getElementById('auth-overlay').style.display = 'flex';
function showPw(){ document.getElementById('pw-row').classList.add('show'); document.getElementById('pw-err').style.display='none'; document.getElementById('pw-input').focus(); }
function checkPw(){
  if (document.getElementById('pw-input').value === 'jdttz2025') {
    sessionStorage.setItem('guzi_role', 'admin');
    document.body.classList.remove('view-only');
    document.getElementById('auth-overlay').remove();
  } else { document.getElementById('pw-err').style.display='block'; }
}
function enterAsMember(){
  sessionStorage.setItem('guzi_role', 'member');
  document.body.classList.add('view-only');
  document.getElementById('auth-overlay').remove();
}

// 定时同步
window.addEventListener('focus', async function() {
  try { await loadState(); render(); } catch(e) {}
});

// 启动
(async function init() {
  try { await loadState(); render(); }
  catch(err) { document.getElementById('app').innerHTML = '<div class="empty">⚠️ 加载失败，请刷新重试<br><small>' + err.message + '</small></div>'; }
})();
</script>
</body>
